category_title: At-risk students with learning disabilities who are shy and struggle to articulate ideas from print text
scenario_title: Comprehending and analyzing print text independently
minimal_context: The student is reviewing their homework and quiz answers based on independent reading of the novel 'Night' in a classroom setting.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's review your homework quiz for the opening chapter of 'Night'. Can you describe why Moishe the Beadle was an important character?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks down at the desk, speaking very quietly) I don't know. I couldn't really write an answer down for that one.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Take a look at the text again. What do you think happened with him?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I read it, but my answers are probably wrong. Even with the descriptions, I was confused with certain things.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What parts of the subsequent chapters were confusing to you?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Like when Idek beat Elie. I still don’t understand why he did that. I wasn’t really sure what the gas chambers and the cattle cars looked like just from reading. It was hard to picture all of it.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's review your homework quiz for the opening chapter of 'Night'. Can you describe why Moishe the Beadle was an important character?

STUDENT: (Looks down at the desk, speaking very quietly) I don't know. I couldn't really write an answer down for that one.

TUTOR: Take a look at the text again. What do you think happened with him?

STUDENT: I read it, but my answers are probably wrong. Even with the descriptions, I was confused with certain things.

TUTOR: What parts of the subsequent chapters were confusing to you?

STUDENT: Like when Idek beat Elie. I still don’t understand why he did that. I wasn’t really sure what the gas chambers and the cattle cars looked like just from reading. It was hard to picture all of it.

task.content: Read subsequent chapters of the novel 'Night' independently and complete associated homework assignments and quizzes
task.learning_goal: Teach students to recognize literary elements, the parts of a short story, and basic poetic elements

context.materials: Novel 'Night', traditional worksheets, Cinego digital movie projector, graphic organizers
context.time_context: Throughout the first half of the school year

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Despite the author’s vivid descriptions, they appeared confused
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Homework answers and quizzes based on the novel contained answers that were incorrect and vague. For example, Alison could not describe why Moishe the Beadle was an important character in the opening chapter.
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: I wasn’t really sure what the gas chambers and the cattle cars looked like just from reading. It was hard to picture all of it
related_quotes: I was confused with certain things like when Idek beat Elie. I still don’t understand why he did that. I wasn’t really sure what the gas chambers and the cattle cars looked like just from reading. It was hard to picture all of it and what it looked like but it was easier after watching the film.

behavior_patterns.condition: Throughout the first half of the school year
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Very shy, reluctant to participate and ask questions, and had difficulties articulating their ideas both orally and in writing.
